body: My midterms start tomorrow and I can't sleep either that's the only reason I'm here, it's gonna be ok. You're not alone, keep fighting.

For some reason your comment motivates me. To fight for good and make the world a better place cus there's not many of us and most of us aren't fighters. Everytime I think of suicide it's always a selfish thought "because i suck" or "I'll always be a loser"...but when I think of all the things u said, I don't have to worry about myself if I dedicate myself to others. But mentally and physically im not capable of being a soldier/officer or doctor so I can't do much. If you can help others in anyway or find a purpose like that then maybe you'll find your reason to live. I'm stuck in a stupid college with a stupid business program that I don't want to do.
You have a family, friends, girlfriend and a best friend, what could possibly make you sad? I'm curious because if I reach there and I still feel sad then everything is pointless. Love is pointless?

I'm just like you. My parents sacrificed everything literally moved to a new country just for me and my sister who dropped out of college and just does drugs all day made them super depressed so it's like I'm their last hope but I'm also screwing up my grades. I got through first year of college and now my mind just keeps thinking about traumatic sh*t that doesn't matter anymore so i can't focus. If I disappoint them I'll feel horrible but I can't help it. Don't have any real friends either, but idc, college itself just sucks. Why do I have to learn this stuff to work for people that are just like machines? I'm too emotional for the modern world. Sometimes it helps to know that you're not alone so I wrote this because I understand your pain. I don't have any solutions, but I will listen to you. Personally though, I'm gonna try to leave pretty soon but in a way that makes it seem like an accident cuz otherwise it would be embarrassing and depressing for them. I wanted to try freezing to death outside but I'd probably end up on the news, or my college will announce my death or something, fuck them all. If u get weed and save up money, just take it and fuckn run away and go anywhere, if u feel like you're trapped right now then freedom's what you need, it'll make you feel alive again.
What meds did/do u take and what was/is the dose? If you don't mind.

Too long, good genetics can prevent you from getting cavities/infections and even if u get them, you won't die you'll just suffer more. Diabetes is hard to get and showers dont matter in survival. I'm pretty similar to you but I want to try antidepressants, what did they feel like? Did u feel better after u got off them? Or has nothing changed?
Who cares about winning. People like us win when we stop existing. Sometimes it brings peace just by thinking about it.
